title: Navigation region synchronization error messages when using too many StaticBodies
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible with Godot 4.3
Reproducible with Godot 4.4
Reproducible with Godot 4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Steam Runtime 2 (soldier) 2 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 61.58 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm working on a game where a map can have a large amount of StaticBodies. When using  NavigationRegion2D, sometimes I get the "ERROR: Navigation region synchronization error. More than 2 edges tried to occupy the same map rasterization space. This is a logical error in the navigation mesh caused by overlap or too densely placed edges." error message.

This breaks the Navigation mesh and NavigationAgents will stop working correctly.
So far, I've been dealing with this by combing the entire map, looking for densely packed meshes or by changing the agent radius.

Is this an issue or the expect behavior? If its expected, is there a good way to deal with this issues?

```
E 0:00:00:745   _build_step_find_edge_connection_pairs: Navigation region synchronization error. More than 2 edges tried to occupy the same map rasterization space. This is a logical error in the navigation mesh caused by overlap or too densely placed edges.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "pair.size >= 2" is true.
  <C++ Source>  modules/navigation_2d/2d/nav_region_builder_2d.cpp:211 @ _build_step_find_edge_connection_pairs()
```

### Steps to reproduce

Open the MRP, run the game.
